preview: An interview experience for the Graduate Analyst role at Deutsche Bank detailing the online assessment, two technical rounds, a Pro-Fit round, and an HR round.
content: Interview Experience Deutsche Bank Piyush H.Motwani, Final Year B.Tech EXTC Student Placements 2023-24 ABOUT COMPANY Role : Graduate Analyst Location : Pune Branches Allowed : CE, IT, EXTC Eligibility : B.Tech Undergraduate - 7 CGPA No Backlogs ONLINE ASSESSMENT The online test was held on the HackerEarth platform on August 4th. There were a total of 3 coding questions with a duration of 90 minutes. The questions were of easy-medium difficulty. 1. Power Limit (20 Pts) A and B are 2 sources given. At each round, we have to select one source. The power of source at a time of selection must be greater than 1. Every second, the power of the selected source gets reduced by 2 and the unselected source gets charged by 1. We have to stop when at least one source has power 0. Sample Input : 3,5 Sample Output : 6 2. Auto Suggest (50 Pts) You are given a query string and an array of strings. Your task is to find the closest string to the given query string using the Levenshtein distance. If two words have the same Levenshtein distance, then the lexicographically smaller word is given priority. Calculated distance for each word given in the array with respect to the query word and selected the minimum one. Query string "apple"; String strings[] =["apples", "banana", "apricot", "grape", "peach"] Output: “apples” 3. Backlink Sorting (50 Pts) We were given an array of web pages title and array of corresponding number of backlinks. The task was to arrange web pages in descending order of backlinks they have. If two web pages have the same number of backlinks, we need to maintain the order. Input: web-pages[] = [“A”, “B”, “C”, “D”] Back-links[] = [10,20,5,10] Output: “C”, “A”, “D”, “B” I was able to solve all three questions and a total of 41 students were selected for interviews. TECHNICAL INTERVIEW I (45 Mins) 1. Introduce Yourself. 2. Asked about Projects, Internship Experience. 3. Interviewer went through each and every skill, technology mentioned in my resume and asked nearly 3-4 questions on each. ( Please don’t fake it in your resume). 4. Difference between setTimeInterval and setTimeOut in JS. 5. What is React? 6. How does React internally work? (Virtual DOM) 7. What is NodeJs, Express? 8. Difference between block and inline elements in HTML. 9. 3-4 more basic questions on development. 10. Then she asked questions on DBMS. a. What is SQL? b. What are joins and different types of joins? c. She gave 3 to 4 sql queries to write the code. d. What is RDBMS? e. What are keys and different types of keys? 11. Then she asked DSA question: Remove duplicates from string. I had done using maps and she was satisfied (Only pseudo code was expected and dry run). 12. Puzzle : 3 Bulbs and 3 Switches. This round was mostly development based and sql oriented. Only one DSA question and one puzzle was asked. TECHNICAL INTERVIEW II (1 hr) 1. Introduce Yourself. 2. Difference between data and information. 3. What is OOP Language, explain four pillars, give real life examples on each pillar. 4. Types of inheritances. 5. Diamond problem and its solution. 6. What is a friend function? 7. Explain Pure virtual function and abstract class in c++. 8. One code was there containing static keywords at 2 3 places in code, I was expected to guess the output. (This was a tricky question, the interviewer asked the reason for the output, she was satisfied with an answer). 9. One scenario was given where I was needed to give the solution. I tried but couldn’t answer. Answer was exceptional handling (try catch blocks). 10. After OOPS she came on DSA and asked the names of sorting algorithms and asked to explain and code merge sort algorithm. 11. Print the pattern for n = 5 12. Difference between array, vector and linked lists. 13. Difference between singly and doubly LL. 14. Delete a node in DLL ( Code and explain) 15. Then she came on SQL Queries, nearly 5 queries were asked to code. 16. Difference between primary key and unique key. 17. Explain process states in OS. 18. She asked me to explain my project. 19. She asked if I had any questions and round 2 concluded. Pro-Fit Round (50 min) 1. Tell me about yourself. 2. Then she asked to explain the group project and asked the difficulties faced during group project. 3. What is SQL and joins in it. Then she asked me to write the queries on the table she had with her. 4. Scenario Questions: a. How will you handle conflicts in a team, if you are team leader? b. What would you do if a sudden bug is noticed in software by a client and you are enjoying the weekend and it is necessary to fix the code and you have less resources? c. If a client is not satisfied with your product and you have met all the requirements, how will you handle such clients? d. Your boss is asking you to do irrelevant work, like go and bring coffee, get my car tank filled with diesel,etc . How will you handle such a situation? e. You are team lead, one member is not doing his work properly, how will you manage him? 5. Puzzle : There are 1000 bottles out of which one bottle contains poison. How many minimum numbers of rats will be required to determine which bottle had poison. 6. Why bank over Product based companies? 7. How do you keep yourself updated with new technologies? 8. She was satisfied with all the answers and asked if I had any questions for her? HR Round (15 min) 1. Tell me about yourself. 2. Asked to explain my all projects and my contribution in group projects. 3. Asked about my family background and family members. 4. He asked if I had any questions? 5. This was a very short round because my interviewer was in hurry and he was receiving lot of calls in between as well. Resources and Tips ●DSA : https://450dsa.com/ ●OS : CodeHelp by Love Babbar ●DBMS : Roadmap by Love Babbar ●OOPS : Roadmap by Love Babbar ●CN : Gate smashers playlist Some Tips: ●When you don’t understand a particular problem statement, do ask for clarifications on it. ●Think out loud. This way the interviewer gets an idea about which direction you are going. ●Always have a look at some interview experiences beforehand. Checkout Geeks For Geeks and COC drive. Very Helpful. ●ALWAYS ASK the interviewer something when they ask you whether you have any questions for them. It shows that you do have interest in the company. ( Ask relevant questions only) ●Prepare for HR and Behavior questions too, we generally prepare technically and ignore behavioral questions. ●Don’t neglect CS fundamentals and don’t leave for the end. ●Be in formal attire and posture, they notice everything while you answer, how you entered the room, how you are leaving the room. ●Don’t lie on your resume. ●Self belief is a key. Always be confident. KEEP CALM AND ALL THE BEST 👍🏻 For any queries reach out to me at Gmail or LinkedIn.
